# The Sabian and Mandaean Familial families' court positions: copies of the Jewish ones (jip_jewish_court_positions.txt)
# under their own names, for heads and holders of their rite (tools/jip_court_flavours.py). Generated by
# make_jewish_court_positions.py.

# Teacher of the family's school, after Thabit ibn Qurra and his pupils. The Rosh Yeshiva's counterpart; the
# Observatory raises the aptitude.
jip_muallim_court_position = {
	sort_order = 255
	max_available_positions = 1
	minimum_rank = county
	skill = learning

	court_position_asset = {
		animation = reading
		background = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/bp2_university_mena.dds"
	}

	opinion = {
		value = regular_court_position_opinion
	}

	aptitude_level_breakpoints = { 20 40 60 80 }

	# root = the holder
	aptitude = {
		value = 1
		add = {
			value = learning
			multiply = 2.5
			max = 60
			desc = court_position_skill_learning
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = lifestyle_scholar }
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = court_position_scholar_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = theologian }
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = court_position_theologian_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = erudite }
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = court_position_erudite_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = diligent }
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = court_position_diligent_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = lazy }
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = court_position_lazy_trait
			}
		}
		# The matching building in the employer's estate (jip_mishpacha_estate_buildings.txt)
		if = {
			limit = {
				employer ?= { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = library_observatory_04 } }
			}
			add = {
				value = jip_yeshiva_rosh_yeshiva_aptitude_2_value
				desc = court_position_jip_observatory
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				employer ?= { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = library_observatory_03 } }
			}
			add = {
				value = jip_yeshiva_rosh_yeshiva_aptitude_1_value
				desc = court_position_jip_observatory
			}
		}
		add = court_position_aptitude_low_penalty_value
		add = general_aptitude_bonus
	}

	# root = the court owner
	is_shown = {
		jip_can_have_sabian_court_positions_trigger = yes
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				highest_held_title_tier <= tier_county
			}
			always = no
		}
	}

	valid_position = {
		jip_can_have_sabian_court_positions_trigger = yes
	}

	is_shown_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			court_position_employee_shown_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	valid_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			jip_sabian_court_position_validity_trigger = { EMPLOYER = scope:liege POS = jip_muallim_court_position }
		}
	}

	revoke_cost = { # root is the liege, no other scopes are passed here!
		prestige = {
			value = minor_court_position_prestige_revoke_cost
			if = {
				limit = { free_court_position_revoke_trigger = { POS = jip_muallim } }
				multiply = 0
			}
		}
	}

	salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = no }
				}
				add = court_tutor_total_salary_value
			}
		}
		treasury = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = yes }
				}
				add = court_tutor_total_salary_value
			}
		}
		prestige = {
			value = court_tutor_prestige_salary_value
		}
		round = no
	}

	received_salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			add = court_tutor_total_salary_value
		}
		prestige = {
			value = court_tutor_prestige_salary_value
		}
		round = no
	}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			monthly_learning_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.04
		}
		poor = {
			monthly_learning_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.08
			monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.02
		}
		average = {
			monthly_learning_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.12
			monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.04
		}
		good = {
			monthly_learning_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.16
			monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.06
		}
		excellent = {
			monthly_learning_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.2
			monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.08
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		learning = 1
		monthly_learning_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.1
	}

	on_court_position_received = {
		basic_gained_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_revoked = {
		basic_revoked_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_invalidated = {
		basic_invalidated_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_vacated = {
		court_position_vacated_event_effect = {
			COURT_POSITION_TYPE = jip_muallim_court_position
		}
	}

	# Hires over 0, fires under -50
	ai_position_score = {
		value = 50
		scope:liege = {
			# A family with a Yeshiva wants someone to lead it
			if = {
				limit = { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = library_observatory_03 } }
				add = 50
			}
		}
		add = court_position_debt_considerations_value
	}
	ai_candidate_score = {
		value = 50
		add = scope:base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_score_base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_aptitude_value
	}
}

# Chief of the priests, who judged the Harranians by their own law. The Av Beit Din's counterpart.
jip_rais_al_kahana_court_position = {
	sort_order = 256
	max_available_positions = 1
	minimum_rank = duchy
	skill = learning

	court_position_asset = {
		animation = personality_zealous
		background = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/councilchamber.dds"
	}

	opinion = {
		value = ceremonial_court_position_opinion
	}

	aptitude_level_breakpoints = { 20 40 60 80 }

	# root = the holder
	aptitude = {
		value = 1
		add = {
			value = learning
			multiply = 2.5
			max = 50
			desc = court_position_skill_learning
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = just }
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = court_position_just_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = honest }
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = court_position_honest_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = temperate }
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = court_position_temperate_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = theologian }
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = court_position_theologian_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = arbitrary }
			add = {
				value = -15
				desc = court_position_arbitrary_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = deceitful }
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = court_position_deceitful_trait
			}
		}
		# The matching building in the employer's estate (jip_mishpacha_estate_buildings.txt)
		if = {
			limit = {
				employer ?= { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = jip_diwan_04 } }
			}
			add = {
				value = jip_beit_din_av_beit_din_aptitude_2_value
				desc = court_position_jip_diwan
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				employer ?= { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = jip_diwan_03 } }
			}
			add = {
				value = jip_beit_din_av_beit_din_aptitude_1_value
				desc = court_position_jip_diwan
			}
		}
		add = court_position_aptitude_low_penalty_value
		add = general_aptitude_bonus
	}

	# root = the court owner
	is_shown = {
		jip_can_have_sabian_court_positions_trigger = yes
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				highest_held_title_tier <= tier_county
			}
			always = no
		}
	}

	valid_position = {
		jip_can_have_sabian_court_positions_trigger = yes
		highest_held_title_tier >= tier_duchy
	}

	is_shown_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			court_position_employee_shown_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	valid_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			jip_sabian_court_position_validity_trigger = { EMPLOYER = scope:liege POS = jip_rais_al_kahana_court_position }
		}
	}

	revoke_cost = { # root is the liege, no other scopes are passed here!
		prestige = {
			value = major_court_position_prestige_revoke_cost
			if = {
				limit = { free_court_position_revoke_trigger = { POS = jip_rais_al_kahana } }
				multiply = 0
			}
		}
	}

	salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = no }
				}
				add = chief_qadi_total_salary_value
			}
		}
		treasury = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = yes }
				}
				add = chief_qadi_total_salary_value
			}
		}
		prestige = {
			value = chief_qadi_prestige_salary_value
		}
		round = no
	}

	received_salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			add = chief_qadi_total_salary_value
		}
		prestige = {
			value = chief_qadi_prestige_salary_value
		}
		round = no
	}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			legitimacy_gain_mult = 0.02
		}
		poor = {
			legitimacy_gain_mult = 0.04
		}
		average = {
			legitimacy_gain_mult = 0.06
			vassal_opinion = 2
		}
		good = {
			legitimacy_gain_mult = 0.08
			vassal_opinion = 3
			enemy_hostile_scheme_phase_duration_add = minor_scheme_phase_duration_malus_value
		}
		excellent = {
			legitimacy_gain_mult = 0.1
			vassal_opinion = 5
			enemy_hostile_scheme_phase_duration_add = medium_scheme_phase_duration_malus_value
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		learning = 1
		monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.1
	}

	on_court_position_received = {
		basic_gained_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_revoked = {
		basic_revoked_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_invalidated = {
		basic_invalidated_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_vacated = {
		court_position_vacated_event_effect = {
			COURT_POSITION_TYPE = jip_rais_al_kahana_court_position
		}
	}

	# Hires over 0, fires under -50
	ai_position_score = {
		value = 50
		scope:liege = {
			if = {
				limit = { ai_zeal >= -25 }
				add = 100
			}
		}
		add = court_position_debt_considerations_value
	}
	ai_candidate_score = {
		value = 50
		add = scope:base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_score_base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_aptitude_value
	}
}

# Poet of the house, as the Sabian secretaries of Baghdad were. The Paytan's counterpart.
jip_shair_court_position = {
	sort_order = 257
	max_available_positions = 1
	minimum_rank = county
	skill = diplomacy

	court_position_asset = {
		animation = storyteller
		background = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/bp1_relaxing_room_mena.dds"
	}

	opinion = {
		value = ceremonial_court_position_opinion
	}

	aptitude_level_breakpoints = { 20 40 60 80 }

	# root = the holder
	aptitude = {
		value = 1
		add = {
			value = diplomacy
			multiply = 2.5
			max = 50
			desc = court_position_skill_diplomacy
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = lifestyle_poet }
			add = {
				value = 25
				desc = court_position_poet_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = theologian }
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = court_position_theologian_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = gregarious }
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = court_position_gregarious_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = shy }
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = court_position_shy_trait
			}
		}
		add = court_position_aptitude_low_penalty_value
		add = general_aptitude_bonus
	}

	# root = the court owner
	is_shown = {
		jip_can_have_sabian_court_positions_trigger = yes
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				highest_held_title_tier <= tier_county
			}
			always = no
		}
	}

	valid_position = {
		jip_can_have_sabian_court_positions_trigger = yes
	}

	is_shown_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			court_position_employee_shown_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	valid_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			jip_sabian_court_position_validity_trigger = { EMPLOYER = scope:liege POS = jip_shair_court_position }
		}
	}

	revoke_cost = { # root is the liege, no other scopes are passed here!
		prestige = {
			value = minor_court_position_prestige_revoke_cost
			if = {
				limit = { free_court_position_revoke_trigger = { POS = jip_shair } }
				multiply = 0
			}
		}
	}

	salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = no }
				}
				add = court_poet_total_salary_value
			}
		}
		treasury = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = yes }
				}
				add = court_poet_total_salary_value
			}
		}
		prestige = {
			value = court_poet_prestige_salary_value
		}
		round = no
	}

	received_salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			add = court_poet_total_salary_value
		}
		prestige = {
			value = court_poet_prestige_salary_value
		}
		round = no
	}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			monthly_prestige_gain_mult = 0.02
			stress_loss_mult = 0.01
		}
		poor = {
			monthly_prestige_gain_mult = 0.04
			stress_loss_mult = 0.025
		}
		average = {
			monthly_prestige_gain_mult = 0.06
			stress_loss_mult = 0.05
		}
		good = {
			monthly_prestige_gain_mult = 0.08
			stress_loss_mult = 0.075
		}
		excellent = {
			monthly_prestige_gain_mult = 0.1
			stress_loss_mult = 0.1
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		diplomacy = 1
	}

	on_court_position_received = {
		basic_gained_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_revoked = {
		basic_revoked_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_invalidated = {
		basic_invalidated_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_vacated = {
		court_position_vacated_event_effect = {
			COURT_POSITION_TYPE = jip_shair_court_position
		}
	}

	# Hires over 0, fires under -50
	ai_position_score = {
		value = 50
		add = court_position_debt_considerations_value
	}
	ai_candidate_score = {
		value = 50
		add = scope:base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_score_base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_aptitude_value
	}
}

# Priest of the planets who keeps the family's rites. The Chazan's counterpart.
jip_kahin_court_position = {
	sort_order = 258
	max_available_positions = 1
	minimum_rank = county
	skill = learning

	court_position_asset = {
		animation = prayer
		background = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/ep2_holysite_mena.dds"
	}

	opinion = {
		value = regular_court_position_opinion
	}

	aptitude_level_breakpoints = { 20 40 60 80 }

	# root = the holder
	aptitude = {
		value = 1
		add = {
			value = learning
			multiply = 2.5
			max = 50
			desc = court_position_skill_learning
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = zealous }
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = court_position_zealous_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = calm }
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = court_position_calm_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = gregarious }
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = court_position_gregarious_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = cynical }
			add = {
				value = -15
				desc = court_position_jip_cynical_trait
			}
		}
		# The matching building in the employer's estate (jip_mishpacha_estate_buildings.txt)
		if = {
			limit = {
				employer ?= { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = jip_haykal_06 } }
			}
			add = {
				value = jip_beit_knesset_chazan_aptitude_3_value
				desc = court_position_jip_haykal
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				employer ?= { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = jip_haykal_05 } }
			}
			add = {
				value = jip_beit_knesset_chazan_aptitude_2_value
				desc = court_position_jip_haykal
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				employer ?= { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = jip_haykal_04 } }
			}
			add = {
				value = jip_beit_knesset_chazan_aptitude_1_value
				desc = court_position_jip_haykal
			}
		}
		add = court_position_aptitude_low_penalty_value
		add = general_aptitude_bonus
	}

	# root = the court owner
	is_shown = {
		jip_can_have_sabian_court_positions_trigger = yes
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				highest_held_title_tier <= tier_county
			}
			always = no
		}
	}

	valid_position = {
		jip_can_have_sabian_court_positions_trigger = yes
	}

	is_shown_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			court_position_employee_shown_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	valid_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			jip_sabian_court_position_validity_trigger = { EMPLOYER = scope:liege POS = jip_kahin_court_position }
		}
	}

	revoke_cost = { # root is the liege, no other scopes are passed here!
		prestige = {
			value = minor_court_position_prestige_revoke_cost
			if = {
				limit = { free_court_position_revoke_trigger = { POS = jip_kahin } }
				multiply = 0
			}
		}
	}

	salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = no }
				}
				add = court_musician_total_salary_value
			}
		}
		treasury = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = yes }
				}
				add = court_musician_total_salary_value
			}
		}
		prestige = {
			value = court_musician_prestige_salary_value
		}
		round = no
	}

	received_salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			add = court_musician_total_salary_value
		}
		prestige = {
			value = court_musician_prestige_salary_value
		}
		round = no
	}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			stress_loss_mult = 0.02
		}
		poor = {
			stress_loss_mult = 0.04
			monthly_piety = 0.1
		}
		average = {
			stress_loss_mult = 0.06
			monthly_piety = 0.2
		}
		good = {
			stress_loss_mult = 0.08
			monthly_piety = 0.3
		}
		excellent = {
			stress_loss_mult = 0.1
			monthly_piety = 0.5
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.1
	}

	on_court_position_received = {
		basic_gained_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_revoked = {
		basic_revoked_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_invalidated = {
		basic_invalidated_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_vacated = {
		court_position_vacated_event_effect = {
			COURT_POSITION_TYPE = jip_kahin_court_position
		}
	}

	# Hires over 0, fires under -50
	ai_position_score = {
		value = 50
		scope:liege = {
			if = {
				limit = { stress_level >= 1 }
				add = 50
			}
		}
		add = court_position_debt_considerations_value
	}
	ai_candidate_score = {
		value = 50
		add = scope:base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_score_base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_aptitude_value

# Almoner of the family's alms. The Gabbai Tzedakah's counterpart.
jip_sabian_almoner_court_position = {
	sort_order = 259
	max_available_positions = 1
	minimum_rank = county
	skill = stewardship

	court_position_asset = {
		animation = personality_compassionate
		background = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/bp1_courtyard_mena.dds"
	}

	opinion = {
		value = regular_court_position_opinion
	}

	aptitude_level_breakpoints = { 20 40 60 80 }

	# root = the holder
	aptitude = {
		value = 1
		add = {
			value = stewardship
			multiply = 2.5
			max = 50
			desc = court_position_skill_stewardship
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = generous }
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = court_position_generous_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = compassionate }
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = court_position_compassionate_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = just }
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = court_position_just_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = greedy }
			add = {
				value = -15
				desc = court_position_greedy_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = callous }
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = court_position_callous_trait
			}
		}
		add = court_position_aptitude_low_penalty_value
		add = general_aptitude_bonus
	}

	# root = the court owner
	is_shown = {
		jip_can_have_sabian_court_positions_trigger = yes
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				highest_held_title_tier <= tier_county
			}
			always = no
		}
	}

	valid_position = {
		jip_can_have_sabian_court_positions_trigger = yes
	}

	is_shown_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			court_position_employee_shown_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	valid_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			jip_sabian_court_position_validity_trigger = { EMPLOYER = scope:liege POS = jip_sabian_almoner_court_position }
		}
	}

	revoke_cost = { # root is the liege, no other scopes are passed here!
		prestige = {
			value = minor_court_position_prestige_revoke_cost
			if = {
				limit = { free_court_position_revoke_trigger = { POS = jip_sabian_almoner } }
				multiply = 0
			}
		}
	}

	salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = no }
				}
				add = {
					value = high_almoner_total_salary_value
					multiply = 1.5 # Also pays for the alms
				}
			}
		}
		treasury = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = yes }
				}
				add = {
					value = high_almoner_total_salary_value
					multiply = 1.5 # Also pays for the alms
				}
			}
		}
		round = no
	}

	received_salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			add = {
				value = high_almoner_total_salary_value
				multiply = 1.5 # Also pays for the alms
			}
		}
		round = no
	}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.02
		}
		poor = {
			monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.05
		}
		average = {
			monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.1
			dualism_religion_opinion = 3
		}
		good = {
			monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.15
			dualism_religion_opinion = 5
		}
		excellent = {
			monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.2
			dualism_religion_opinion = 10
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		monthly_piety = 0.1
		monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.05
	}

	on_court_position_received = {
		basic_gained_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_revoked = {
		basic_revoked_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_invalidated = {
		basic_invalidated_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_vacated = {
		court_position_vacated_event_effect = {
			COURT_POSITION_TYPE = jip_sabian_almoner_court_position
		}
	}

	# Hires over 0, fires under -50
	ai_position_score = {
		value = 50
		scope:liege = {
			if = {
				limit = { ai_zeal >= 0 }
				add = 50
			}
		}
		add = court_position_debt_considerations_value
	}
	ai_candidate_score = {
		value = 50
		add = scope:base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_score_base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_aptitude_value
	}
}

# Envoy between the Sabians of Harran and of Baghdad. The Shaliach's counterpart.
jip_rasul_court_position = {
	sort_order = 260
	max_available_positions = 1
	minimum_rank = duchy
	skill = diplomacy

	court_position_asset = {
		animation = throne_room_conversation_1
		background = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/market_east.dds"
	}

	opinion = {
		value = regular_court_position_opinion
	}

	aptitude_level_breakpoints = { 20 40 60 80 }

	# root = the holder
	aptitude = {
		value = 1
		add = {
			value = diplomacy
			multiply = 2.5
			max = 50
			desc = court_position_skill_diplomacy
		}
		add = {
			value = num_of_known_languages
			subtract = 1
			multiply = 5
			max = 25
			desc = court_position_languages
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = diplomat }
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = court_position_diplomat_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = lifestyle_traveler }
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = court_position_traveler_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = gregarious }
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = court_position_gregarious_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = shy }
			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = court_position_shy_trait
			}
		}
		add = court_position_aptitude_low_penalty_value
		add = general_aptitude_bonus
	}

	# root = the court owner
	is_shown = {
		jip_can_have_sabian_court_positions_trigger = yes
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				highest_held_title_tier <= tier_county
			}
			always = no
		}
	}

	valid_position = {
		jip_can_have_sabian_court_positions_trigger = yes
		highest_held_title_tier >= tier_duchy
	}

	is_shown_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			court_position_employee_shown_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	valid_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			jip_sabian_court_position_validity_trigger = { EMPLOYER = scope:liege POS = jip_rasul_court_position }
		}
	}

	revoke_cost = { # root is the liege, no other scopes are passed here!

			value = minor_court_position_prestige_revoke_cost
			if = {
				limit = { free_court_position_revoke_trigger = { POS = jip_rasul } }
				multiply = 0
			}
		}
	}

	salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = no }
				}
				add = cultural_emissary_total_salary_value
			}
		}
		treasury = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = yes }
				}
				add = cultural_emissary_total_salary_value
			}
		}
		prestige = {
			value = cultural_emissary_prestige_salary_value
		}
		round = no
	}

	received_salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			add = cultural_emissary_total_salary_value
		}
		prestige = {
			value = cultural_emissary_prestige_salary_value
		}
		round = no
	}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			diplomatic_range_mult = 0.05
			dualism_religion_opinion = 2
		}
		poor = {
			diplomatic_range_mult = 0.1
			dualism_religion_opinion = 4
		}
		average = {
			diplomatic_range_mult = 0.15
			dualism_religion_opinion = 6
		}
		good = {
			diplomatic_range_mult = 0.2
			dualism_religion_opinion = 8
		}
		excellent = {
			diplomatic_range_mult = 0.25
			dualism_religion_opinion = 10
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		diplomacy = 1
		monthly_diplomacy_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.1
	}

	on_court_position_received = {
		basic_gained_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_revoked = {
		basic_revoked_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_invalidated = {
		basic_invalidated_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_vacated = {
		court_position_vacated_event_effect = {
			COURT_POSITION_TYPE = jip_rasul_court_position
		}
	}

	# Hires over 0, fires under -50
	ai_position_score = {
		value = 50
		scope:liege = {
			# The diaspora network matters most to a family without land
			if = {
				limit = { jip_can_have_sabian_court_positions_trigger = yes }
				add = 50
			}
		}
		add = court_position_debt_considerations_value

# Agent who collects the community's dues for the family. The Parnas' counterpart.
jip_sabian_wakil_court_position = {
	sort_order = 262
	max_available_positions = 1
	minimum_rank = county
	skill = stewardship

	court_position_asset = {
		animation = holding_staff
		background = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/ep3_medi_market.dds"
	}

	opinion = {
		value = regular_court_position_opinion
	}

	aptitude_level_breakpoints = { 20 40 60 80 }

	# root = the holder
	aptitude = {
		value = 1
		add = {
			value = stewardship
			multiply = 2.5
			max = 50
			desc = court_position_skill_stewardship
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = just }
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = court_position_just_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = honest }
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = court_position_honest_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = greedy }
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = court_position_greedy_trait
			}
		}
		# The matching building in the employer's estate (jip_mishpacha_estate_buildings.txt)
		if = {
			limit = {
				employer ?= { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = jip_counting_house_04 } }
			}
			add = {
				value = jip_counting_house_parnas_aptitude_2_value
				desc = court_position_jip_employer_counting_house
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				employer ?= { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = jip_counting_house_02 } }
			}
			add = {
				value = jip_counting_house_parnas_aptitude_1_value
				desc = court_position_jip_employer_counting_house
			}
		}
		add = court_position_aptitude_low_penalty_value
		add = general_aptitude_bonus
	}

	# root = the court owner

		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				highest_held_title_tier <= tier_county
			}
			always = no
		}
	}

		jip_can_have_sabian_court_positions_trigger = yes
	}

	is_shown_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			court_position_employee_shown_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	valid_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			jip_sabian_court_position_validity_trigger = { EMPLOYER = scope:liege POS = jip_sabian_wakil_court_position }
		}
	}

	revoke_cost = { # root is the liege, no other scopes are passed here!

			value = minor_court_position_prestige_revoke_cost
			if = {
				limit = { free_court_position_revoke_trigger = { POS = jip_sabian_wakil } }
				multiply = 0
			}
		}
	}

	salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = no }
				}
				add = seneschal_total_salary_value
			}
		}
		treasury = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = yes }
				}
				add = seneschal_total_salary_value
			}
		}
		prestige = {
			value = seneschal_prestige_salary_value
		}
		round = no
	}

	received_salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			add = seneschal_total_salary_value
		}
		prestige = {
			value = seneschal_prestige_salary_value
		}
		round = no
	}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			domicile_monthly_gold_add = 0.05
		}
		poor = {
			domicile_monthly_gold_add = 0.1
		}
		average = {
			domicile_monthly_gold_add = 0.15
		}
		good = {
			domicile_monthly_gold_add = 0.2
		}
		excellent = {
			domicile_monthly_gold_add = 0.3
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		stewardship = 1
	}

	on_court_position_received = {
		basic_gained_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_revoked = {
		basic_revoked_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_invalidated = {
		basic_invalidated_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_vacated = {
		court_position_vacated_event_effect = {
			COURT_POSITION_TYPE = jip_sabian_wakil_court_position
		}
	}

	# Hires over 0, fires under -50
	ai_position_score = {
		value = 50
		scope:liege = {
			if = {
				limit = { gold < 0 }
				add = 50
			}
		}
		add = court_position_debt_considerations_value
	}
	ai_candidate_score = {
		value = 50
		add = scope:base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_score_base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_aptitude_value
	}

			add = {
				value = -10
				desc = court_position_lazy_trait
			}
		}
		# The matching building in the employer's estate (jip_mishpacha_estate_buildings.txt)
		if = {
			limit = {
				employer ?= { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = jip_scriptorium_04 } }
			}
			add = {
				value = jip_yeshiva_rosh_yeshiva_aptitude_2_value
				desc = court_position_jip_scriptorium
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				employer ?= { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = jip_scriptorium_03 } }
			}
			add = {
				value = jip_yeshiva_rosh_yeshiva_aptitude_1_value
				desc = court_position_jip_scriptorium
			}
		}
		add = court_position_aptitude_low_penalty_value
		add = general_aptitude_bonus
	}

	# root = the court owner
	is_shown = {
		jip_can_have_mandaean_court_positions_trigger = yes
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				highest_held_title_tier <= tier_county
			}
			always = no
		}
	}

	valid_position = {
		jip_can_have_mandaean_court_positions_trigger = yes
	}

	is_shown_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			court_position_employee_shown_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	valid_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			jip_mandaean_court_position_validity_trigger = { EMPLOYER = scope:liege POS = jip_ganzibra_court_position }
		}
	}

	revoke_cost = { # root is the liege, no other scopes are passed here!
		prestige = {
			value = minor_court_position_prestige_revoke_cost
			if = {
				limit = { free_court_position_revoke_trigger = { POS = jip_ganzibra } }
				multiply = 0
			}
		}
	}

	salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = no }
				}
				add = court_tutor_total_salary_value
			}
		}
		treasury = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = yes }
				}
				add = court_tutor_total_salary_value
			}
		}
		prestige = {
			value = court_tutor_prestige_salary_value
		}
		round = no
	}

	received_salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			add = court_tutor_total_salary_value
		}
		prestige = {
			value = court_tutor_prestige_salary_value
		}
		round = no
	}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			monthly_learning_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.04
		}
		poor = {
			monthly_learning_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.08
			monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.02
		}
		average = {
			monthly_learning_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.12
			monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.04
		}
		good = {
			monthly_learning_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.16
			monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.06
		}
		excellent = {
			monthly_learning_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.2
			monthly_piety_gain_mult = 0.08
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		learning = 1
		monthly_learning_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.1
	}

	on_court_position_received = {
		basic_gained_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_revoked = {
		basic_revoked_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_invalidated = {
		basic_invalidated_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_vacated = {
		court_position_vacated_event_effect = {
			COURT_POSITION_TYPE = jip_ganzibra_court_position
		}
	}

	# Hires over 0, fires under -50
	ai_position_score = {
		value = 50
		scope:liege = {
			# A family with a Yeshiva wants someone to lead it
			if = {
				limit = { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = jip_scriptorium_03 } }
				add = 50
			}
		}
		add = court_position_debt_considerations_value
	}
	ai_candidate_score = {
		value = 50
		add = scope:base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_score_base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_aptitude_value
	}
}

# The tarmida, the priest who baptises in living water. The Chazan's counterpart.
jip_tarmida_court_position = {
	sort_order = 278
	max_available_positions = 1
	minimum_rank = county
	skill = learning

	court_position_asset = {
		animation = prayer
		background = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/ep2_holysite_mena.dds"
	}

	opinion = {
		value = regular_court_position_opinion
	}

	aptitude_level_breakpoints = { 20 40 60 80 }

	# root = the holder
	aptitude = {
		value = 1
		add = {
			value = learning
			multiply = 2.5
			max = 50
			desc = court_position_skill_learning
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = zealous }
			add = {
				value = 15
				desc = court_position_zealous_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = calm }
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = court_position_calm_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = gregarious }
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = court_position_gregarious_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = cynical }
			add = {
				value = -15
				desc = court_position_jip_cynical_trait
			}
		}
		# The matching building in the employer's estate (jip_mishpacha_estate_buildings.txt)
		if = {
			limit = {
				employer ?= { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = jip_mandi_06 } }
			}
			add = {
				value = jip_beit_knesset_chazan_aptitude_3_value
				desc = court_position_jip_mandi
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				employer ?= { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = jip_mandi_05 } }
			}
			add = {
				value = jip_beit_knesset_chazan_aptitude_2_value
				desc = court_position_jip_mandi
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				employer ?= { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = jip_mandi_04 } }
			}
			add = {
				value = jip_beit_knesset_chazan_aptitude_1_value
				desc = court_position_jip_mandi
			}
		}
		add = court_position_aptitude_low_penalty_value
		add = general_aptitude_bonus
	}

	# root = the court owner
	is_shown = {
		jip_can_have_mandaean_court_positions_trigger = yes
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				highest_held_title_tier <= tier_county
			}
			always = no
		}
	}

		jip_can_have_mandaean_court_positions_trigger = yes
	}

	is_shown_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			court_position_employee_shown_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	valid_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			jip_mandaean_court_position_validity_trigger = { EMPLOYER = scope:liege POS = jip_tarmida_court_position }
		}
	}

	revoke_cost = { # root is the liege, no other scopes are passed here!
		prestige = {
			value = minor_court_position_prestige_revoke_cost
			if = {
				limit = { free_court_position_revoke_trigger = { POS = jip_tarmida } }
				multiply = 0
			}
		}
	}

	salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = no }
				}
				add = court_musician_total_salary_value
			}
		}
		treasury = {

		prestige = {

		}
		round = no

		poor = {

			monthly_piety = 0.1

	# Hires over 0, fires under -50

			always = no
		}
	}

	valid_position = {
		jip_can_have_mandaean_court_positions_trigger = yes
	}

	is_shown_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			court_position_employee_shown_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	valid_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			jip_mandaean_court_position_validity_trigger = { EMPLOYER = scope:liege POS = jip_sapra_court_position }
		}
	}

	revoke_cost = { # root is the liege, no other scopes are passed here!
		prestige = {
			value = minor_court_position_prestige_revoke_cost
			if = {
				limit = { free_court_position_revoke_trigger = { POS = jip_sapra } }
				multiply = 0
			}
		}
	}

	salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = no }
				}
				add = seneschal_total_salary_value
			}
		}
		treasury = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = yes }
				}
				add = seneschal_total_salary_value
			}
		}
		prestige = {
			value = seneschal_prestige_salary_value
		}
		round = no
	}

	received_salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			add = seneschal_total_salary_value
		}
		prestige = {
			value = seneschal_prestige_salary_value
		}
		round = no
	}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			monthly_stewardship_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.04
			legitimacy_loss_mult = -0.05
		}
		poor = {
			monthly_stewardship_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.08
			legitimacy_loss_mult = -0.1
		}
		average = {
			monthly_stewardship_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.12
			stewardship = 1
			legitimacy_loss_mult = -0.15
			monthly_dynasty_prestige = 0.02
		}
		good = {
			monthly_stewardship_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.16
			stewardship = 2
			legitimacy_loss_mult = -0.2
			monthly_dynasty_prestige = 0.04
		}
		excellent = {
			monthly_stewardship_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.2
			stewardship = 3
			legitimacy_loss_mult = -0.25
			monthly_dynasty_prestige = 0.07
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		stewardship = 1
		monthly_prestige = 0.25
	}

	on_court_position_received = {
		basic_gained_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_revoked = {
		basic_revoked_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_invalidated = {
		basic_invalidated_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_vacated = {
		court_position_vacated_event_effect = {
			COURT_POSITION_TYPE = jip_sapra_court_position
		}
	}

	# Hires over 0, fires under -50
	ai_position_score = {
		value = 50
		add = court_position_debt_considerations_value
	}
	ai_candidate_score = {
		value = 50
		add = scope:base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_score_base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_aptitude_value
	}
}

# Agent who collects the community's dues for the family. The Parnas' counterpart.
jip_mandaean_wakil_court_position = {
	sort_order = 282
	max_available_positions = 1
	minimum_rank = county
	skill = stewardship

	court_position_asset = {
		animation = holding_staff
		background = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/ep3_medi_market.dds"
	}

	opinion = {
		value = regular_court_position_opinion
	}

	aptitude_level_breakpoints = { 20 40 60 80 }

	# root = the holder
	aptitude = {
		value = 1
		add = {
			value = stewardship
			multiply = 2.5
			max = 50
			desc = court_position_skill_stewardship
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = just }
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = court_position_just_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = honest }
			add = {
				value = 10
				desc = court_position_honest_trait
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = greedy }
			add = {
				value = 5
				desc = court_position_greedy_trait
			}
		}
		# The matching building in the employer's estate (jip_mishpacha_estate_buildings.txt)
		if = {
			limit = {
				employer ?= { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = jip_counting_house_04 } }
			}
			add = {
				value = jip_counting_house_parnas_aptitude_2_value
				desc = court_position_jip_employer_counting_house
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				employer ?= { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = jip_counting_house_02 } }
			}
			add = {
				value = jip_counting_house_parnas_aptitude_1_value
				desc = court_position_jip_employer_counting_house
			}
		}
		add = court_position_aptitude_low_penalty_value
		add = general_aptitude_bonus
	}

	# root = the court owner
	is_shown = {
		jip_can_have_mandaean_court_positions_trigger = yes
		trigger_if = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				highest_held_title_tier <= tier_county
			}
			always = no
		}
	}

	valid_position = {
		jip_can_have_mandaean_court_positions_trigger = yes
	}

	is_shown_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			court_position_employee_shown_trigger = yes
		}
	}

	valid_character = {
		scope:employee = {
			jip_mandaean_court_position_validity_trigger = { EMPLOYER = scope:liege POS = jip_mandaean_wakil_court_position }
		}
	}

	revoke_cost = { # root is the liege, no other scopes are passed here!
		prestige = {
			value = minor_court_position_prestige_revoke_cost
			if = {
				limit = { free_court_position_revoke_trigger = { POS = jip_mandaean_wakil } }
				multiply = 0
			}
		}
	}

	salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = no }
				}
				add = seneschal_total_salary_value
			}
		}
		treasury = {
			value = 0
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:liege = { has_treasury = yes }
				}
				add = seneschal_total_salary_value
			}
		}
		prestige = {
			value = seneschal_prestige_salary_value
		}
		round = no
	}

	received_salary = {
		gold = {
			value = 0
			add = seneschal_total_salary_value
		}
		prestige = {
			value = seneschal_prestige_salary_value
		}
		round = no
	}

	scaling_employer_modifiers = {
		terrible = {
			domicile_monthly_gold_add = 0.05
		}
		poor = {
			domicile_monthly_gold_add = 0.1
		}
		average = {
			domicile_monthly_gold_add = 0.15
		}
		good = {
			domicile_monthly_gold_add = 0.2
		}
		excellent = {
			domicile_monthly_gold_add = 0.3
		}
	}

	modifier = {
		stewardship = 1
	}

	on_court_position_received = {
		basic_gained_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_revoked = {
		basic_revoked_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_invalidated = {
		basic_invalidated_court_position_effect = yes
	}
	on_court_position_vacated = {
		court_position_vacated_event_effect = {
			COURT_POSITION_TYPE = jip_mandaean_wakil_court_position
		}
	}

	# Hires over 0, fires under -50
	ai_position_score = {
		value = 50
		scope:liege = {
			if = {
				limit = { gold < 0 }
				add = 50
			}
		}
		add = court_position_debt_considerations_value
	}
	ai_candidate_score = {
		value = 50
		add = scope:base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_score_base_value
		add = court_position_candidate_aptitude_value
	}
}
